steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Metal finishes - functional: galvanising (zinc coating prevents rust), anodising (thickened aluminium oxide layer - harder, can be dyed), plating (chromium/nickel for hardness). Decorative: powder coating (baked polymer - durable, many colours), painting (versatile but less durable). | Key Fact: Timber finishes - functional: preservative (prevents rot), fire retardant. Decorative: varnish (clear, highlights grain, waterproof), oil (penetrates wood, natural), wax (soft sheen, less durable), paint (opaque, hides grain), stain (changes colour, shows grain). | Key Fact: Polymer finishes - self-finishing (coloured in the mould).
